abilities.critical_failure: As failure, but sickened 2 and 1d6 persistent nonlethal damage.
abilities.critical_success: The creature is unaffected by the smoke.
abilities.effect: The triggering creature must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save.
abilities.failure: The creature is sickened 1 and takes 1d6 nonlethal damage from choking on the smoke. A creature that falls unconscious from the nonlethal damage begins to suffocate in 1d4+1 rounds if not dragged to safety.
abilities.name: Choke
abilities.success: The creature is sickened 1 by the smoke.
abilities.trigger: A creature that isn't holding their breath walks into the hallway or starts their turn in the hallway

hazard.description: Thick smoke fills this hallway, making it difficult to see and breathe.
hazard.disable: While a spell like *gust of wind* can temporarily clear a path through the smoke, the hazard returns at the start of the next round as long as the fires in area A17 continue to burn; DC 18 Survival to know how best to cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth to help alleviate the choking effects of the smoke.
hazard.name: Smoke-Filled Hallway
hazard.reset: The smoke continues to affect anyone who enters area A16 until the fires in area A17 are extinguished.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
